text:
deploy-bot: Canary publish blocked: image push succeeded but provenance verification failed for sha:sha256:8f3a...517. Holding canary rollout.
Alex M: Ugh. summary? is the image in the registry at least?
deploy-bot: yes image present in eu-ecr (redwood-app:staging-2026-03-21). provenance attestation missing TTL header -> cosign verify failed. error: "no valid attestation".
Priya R: Pushing logs:
```
cosign verify-attestation --attestation=/tmp/att.json eu.ecr.redwood.io/redwood-app@sha256:8f3a...517
error: attestation not found
```
Priya R: Also saw the CI job used ephemeral buildkit cache that skipped the attestation step (CI job v312).
Josh T: Options: 1) Pin services to previous digest and rollback canary, 2) Retag current digest after re-running attestation, or 3) Proceed with a forced publish (no). Thoughts?
Carla S: We should avoid forced publish. we have a change window at 17:00 UTC; current time 15:20. I'd prefer pin-and-rebuild so we don't risk production.
Liam P: +1 pin. quick rollback plan: update k8s deployment imageRef to previous digest sha256:d1a2...999 for staging canary, let it run through smoke, then trigger CI to rebuild with attestation and re-run canary.
Alex M: Can someone confirm previous digest is still available in the registry?
Priya R: Confirmed: eu.ecr.redwood.io/redwood-app@sha256:d1a2...999 exists and has valid provenance from yesterday.
Josh T: Steps I can take: apply pin to staging canary, create a short release note entry, and queue rebuild job. I'll need an approver for immediate k8s patch.
Carla S: @Josh T go ahead. I'll approve the k8s patch. add a note in the release notes: 'staging canary pinned due to attestation mismatch; rebuilding image to reattach provenance.'
Alex M: For the rebuild, add explicit cosign sign step and upload attestation artifact to our provenance S3 bucket. Use the same BUILD_ID and set ATT_TTL.
Priya R: i'll update CI job template: ensure `BUILD_ATTEST=true` and `COSIGN_KEY_REF=kms://projects/redwood/keys/ci-signer`. Also added a guard so deploy-bot will reject pushes without attestation header.
deploy-bot: Manual pin applied to staging canary: deployment/redwood-app-canary -> eu.ecr.redwood.io/redwood-app@sha256:d1a2...999 (requested by Josh T).
Josh T: Patch applied, smoke tests running. ETA ~8m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Carla S: Adding to release notes (internal) under 2026-03-21 change window. @Alex M do we want a public blurb?
Alex M: Not necessary for customers; internal release notes only. Track follow-up in the release ticket.
Priya R: After rebuild completes I will run: 
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/ci-signer eu.ecr.redwood.io/redwood-app@sha256:NEWDIGEST
```
and paste the attestation digest here.
Liam P: If attestation still fails on rebuild, fallback is to ban this CI runner image and trigger full clean rebuild on another runner.
deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed on pinned digest. Canary healthy. Rebuild queued (job id: build-3728).
Josh T: thanks all. I'll follow up when build-3728 finishes and update the release ticket with final digest + attestation. :thumbsup:
